prompt: Stage 2-1 augment round. You hold a pair of Caitlyn with a Recurve Bow and a B.F. Sword and are leaning toward a Caitlyn reroll. Read the scout report on the four boards that matter. Which players are actually on your line? Pick every one that is.

lobby.note: Caitlyn 1-star on the board next to Camille and Elise, a Recurve Bow on the bench
Two Caitlyns on the bench, Sparring Gloves and a Chain Vest
Leona, Kayle and Sejuani on the board, holding a Chain Vest
Xayah with a Recurve Bow, Ornn and Alistar beside her

options.label: Seat 2: Caitlyn on the board with two Coven units and a Bow
Seat 4: two Caitlyns kept on the bench
Seat 6: three Solar units and a Chain Vest
Seat 7: Xayah holding a Recurve Bow

explanation:
Contest at 2-1 shows in units and kept pairs, not in components. Seat 2 has Caitlyn on the board with two other Coven units and a Bow waiting: a Coven or Hunter opener built on the 2-cost you want. Seat 4 has no Caitlyn on the board but two on the bench, and a pair kept on the bench at 2-1 is a player planning to 2-star her. Those two are on your line.

Seat 7 holds a Bow too, which is why players misread it, but the Bow is on Xayah with two Elderwood units: a different carry and a different trait. A flexible component is not evidence of a line. Seat 6 is three Solar units and a Vest, with no overlap.

The arithmetic: Caitlyn has 25 copies. You hold 2, Seat 2 holds 1, Seat 4 holds 2, so 20 remain and a 3-star needs 7 more from a pool two other players buy from every round. Contest is soft at 2-1, so you do not sell, but you stop investing: no rolling for her, keep both lines the Bow and Sword can build, and re-count at 3-2.
principle: Read contest from units and kept pairs; a component on a bench is a flexible item, not a line.
commonMistake: Counting every player holding a Bow as a Caitlyn contester and missing the one with two copies on the bench.
hint: For each board, look at which units are kept together and which are paired on the bench, before you look at the items.
